title: Turn Dead Git Branches Into a Cleanup Script
hook: Run your raw git history through a browser-side intent parser to generate a safe, executable local cleanup script.
waste_source: Unmerged, stale local branches tracked in git for-each-ref
free_ai_mechanism: Browser-native text classification and chronological intent parsing via JavaScript
asymmetry_note: Incumbents charge subscriptions to manage branches centrally; this workflow uses local text-paste compute, bypassing the need for OAuth and cloud sync entirely.

title: Turn Dead Git Commit Branches Into an Organized Snippet Library
hook: Extracts intent and recurring patterns from abandoned git commit histories entirely in your browser at genuine $0 cost.
waste_source: Stale git log outputs and abandoned local branch histories sitting idle in your workspace.
free_ai_mechanism: Client-side vanilla JavaScript heuristic regex parsing and local array grouping.
asymmetry_note: Commercial code intelligence suites charge recurring subscription fees to parse internal repository metadata that is already fully stored on your local disk.

title: Turn Raw Server Error Logs Into Actionable Triage Reports
hook: Parse messy server logs and crash reports entirely client-side in your browser, clustering error signatures into triage tickets at zero cost.
waste_source: Raw server error logs and unread daemon outputs
free_ai_mechanism: Client-side heuristic regex tokenization and frequency clustering engine
asymmetry_note: Enterprise APM platforms charge for centralized ingestion pipelines; client-side execution bypasses server infrastructure costs entirely.

title: Turn Scattered Markdown Notes Into an Instant Searchable Knowledge Base
